nom: TULA 24-7 Moisture Intense Ultra Hydrating Day & Night Cream

avis.titre: I've been using this product for several years
avis.texte: I really like this product. It doesn't take very much. I use it under makeup in the morning and after I wash my face at night.

avis.titre: I think I got a bad batch.
avis.texte: The images show a creamy texture, but the .5 ounce size I bought has the consistency of mochi that I have to use a spatula or (clean) fingernails to scoop out. As such, it feels like putting on a heavy balm on my face that isn't fully absorbing into the skin. Not sure this is what was intended?
I did not find the product moisturizing enough for mature skin
I bought a mini to try this out. Im sold. I love the light scent, how easy it is to spread on the skin, and how moisturized its leaving my skin. The change is noticable to others.
This felt so nice on my skin I was sure it was going to be a great product. Unfortunately, it leaces my skin feeling dry within a few hours :( Hopefully this is better for other folks!
This is one of my favorite moisturizers. Is is very creamy and feels refreshing, and absorbs nicely into my skin. It doesnt feel like it just sits on my skin.

avis.titre: Broke me out, but great feel
avis.texte: I really love the way this spreads on my face, it like melts into your skin as you rub it in and you don't need that much. This would be great for someone who doesn't EVER get pimples. This unfortunately broke me out ALOT, like straight up cystic and fungal acne. I haven't had acne in over 3 months and once I started using it, it broke me out. So doesn't work for me but might work for you.

This is great. It works well on my skin. Im not even kidding, i washed my face and put this on, a few minutes later my boyfriend comes in amd starts going on and on about how good my skin looks. He proceeded to TAKE HIS PHONE OUT AND TAKE A PIC OF ME BAREFACE, and now its his background. All on his own accord… so this stuff may actually bring miracles into your life. Its also very hydrating and works great under makeup!

I read a comment that someone said its too much for their skin. First if you have oily or combination skin dont buy this is truly for normal to more dry skin and give the hydration that my face needs!

I never leave reviews but im super confused by all the good reviews for this!?! Maybe i got a faulty one or something but this product is terrible. It dries my skin out so much and is too thick to even rub in, i feel like this would only last me a month since you have to use so much of it... The fragrance is also a no go for me- day 3 of using this and already noticing a ton of little bumps and break outs appearing ugh definitely will be returning this /:
This feels so good and super hydrating on my face... This is my second buying. I think I've fallen in love with it.....
This is the most moisturizing moisturizer I have ever used. Without a doubt. A little goes a long way so I have made the sample size last a long time. Definitely worth the buy!!

avis.titre: dries out my face over night
avis.texte: the regular 24-hour hydrating day/night Tula cream works fine. the intense cream totally pulls all of the moisture out of my face. my face is completely dried out every time I use this. I will not be purchasing this item again.
This is my favorite moisture thus far. Feels thick enough in the container but doesn't feel like that on my face LOVE
This is the best moisturizer! My skin feels hydrated and soft when I use it. It's one of my favorites and I keep re-ordering.

This intense moisturizer I wear everyday before I put my makeup on. It absorbs into my face so well. Not oily. Has helped with my wrinkles too. I thought I would use it only in the winter and switch to the lighter tula moisturizer for summer. But honestly you can use intense moisturizer year round. Tula makes fabulous moisturizers. Products good for your skin. Thank you.
If your skin is dry, you need this! It's heavy, but it soaks in fast.

Where I live, the weather is very up and down, not just temperature but also humidity. A cold dry day can make your skin feel chapped. Since using this 3 months ago, I haven't had that feeling. On top of that, It is lite enough, that I don't feel like my face is oily.
LOVE this product! Intense moisture with a clean scent. I'm a Tula girl forever!!
Love the way this moisturizer smells compared to the other day & night cream and love the way it feels on my skin!

I have dry, sensitive skin and am starting to worry about the effects of aging. I hoped this would be my holy grail. Despite being non-comodegenic, I think it broke me out. It was too heavy/sticky for me/my husband to try it more than a couple times

I love Tula products however this Ultra moisturizing cream doesn't seem to cut it. I use the regular moisturizer and love it. I thought I'd try this ultra moisturizer at night, but it is sort of hard to get out of jar. Maybe that's what it's supposed to be like, but I prefer a creamier product. Takes a while to massage into face because of its thickness.
I noticed my skin looks plump and refreshed after just once use. This is my new favorite moisturizer. And a little goes a long way. Truly a game changer!
I usually use the OG 24/7 moisturizer, but this was great especially since I just traveled back from the beach to a dry and cold climate.

I chose this for a FFF box. I struggle with redness, tiny pimples, itching and burning on my cheeks and forehead from rosecea. I applied this after my HA serum and it kept my itching, burning and spots away every day I used it. My skin felt so plump and hydrated, with slightly reduced redness. I'm saving up to put this amazing cream again. The texture is thick, but absorbed well. Love it a lot!!

avis.titre: This is the first skin pr
avis.texte: This is the first skin product that I have ever bought in the supersize- it's noticeably better on my skin than other moisturizers. I used the regular 24/7 cream for years before this released, and I liked it but this one does such a great job in the winter. I have normal to dry skin and this keeps my skin nice and hydated without being heavy, and a little of it goes a long way!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: This product is very thick and little bit goes a long way. I have been using it consistently for a week and my skin feels so soft. My skin has the tendency to be very dry and flaky especially with it being so cold and windy. My skin is loving the extra moisture it is getting.
Great winter moisturizer to hydrate my skin. I have combination skin, but have been extra dry this winter. This formula has provided me relief and it smells great!
It's so light but hydrating! My face gets so dry, especially in the winter and this stuff works wonders!
Love this moisturizer, especially in the wintertime! Very creamy and hydrating, with a clean, subtle scent. Will be buying again!
The best moisturizer I've used!! Definitely helps my aging skin!

avis.titre: Amazing moisturizer - perfect for cold weather
avis.texte: I received the 24-7 moisture intense as a thank you. I thought can this really be different from the 24-7 moisture. Well it absolutely is. It's an amazing product. We've had below freezing temperatures for a few weeks and the 24-7 moisture intense makes my face feel great, moist, not sticky or greasy. It's a firmer cream than the regular moisturizer, however it goes on smoothly and leaves my face feeling wonderful. I definitely recommend giving this a try.
With all the cold weather here, my skin had been very dry. This lotion has helped so much in keeping my skin hydrated!
Perfect addition to my night time skin care routine. So buttery and moisturizing. It is too thick for me to use during the daytime under my makeup, but I just use the original tula for that :)
My absolute favorite!!!!❤️ I don't like to even let my jar get to half empty before I am buying another.
This is an excellent moisturizer for dry and irritated skin!I use it nightly after my prescription acne treatments and it really helps keep my skin hydrated and is very soothing.
This is the only moisturizer that works to prevent dry skin in the cold winter months! It's thick, but fleshy feel to heavy/oily on my skin. My absolute favorite!!
I love this cream because keep my skin so smooth and moisture.

I love this day and night cream! It goes on super nice helps hydrate during the night and it doesn't feel heavy underneath my makeup during the day!! you don't need a whole lot with each application. I will definitely purchase this again!

This is the most amazing lotion! Goes on so smooth and light even though it's a thick texture. I saw more hydrated skin within days of starting to use the lotion. It is quick absorbing and doesn't affect my makeups's application. Definitely a new favorite!
I have very oily sensitive skin and I love this for my nighttime moisturizer in the winter! It gives my skin the umph it needs in the dry winter months. It's so smooth and feels amazing on my skin!

Good cream, very hydrated and perfect for this dry winter weather. I love the texture and that fact that isn't very heavy on skin, it absolutely makes my skin looks better, healthier, and plumped. Thanks
This moisturizer is nice and thick without making me feel greasy! It doesn't have a strong smell, which I love! It's my favorite night time moisturizer.
Too thick, does not smell good, I prefer the original day night cream but I think this is more moisturizing. Wish I had got the original .

Its gifted by Tula. its rich, creamy texture feels luxurious without being greasy, and it absorbs quickly and leaving my skin feeling instantly hydrated and supple. I suggest use it as night cream. Maybe it's not friendly with daily makeup.

This cream is very thick and does not smell too strong, it goes on well but has to be rubbed in well to avoid having a white cast on my face. I tend to have dry skin so this thick cream is good for hydrating my skin. I like how it feels on my face and I tend to use this in the day, not at night. Gifted by Tula.

This cream is a must-have for anyone with dry skin. It's so hydrating and nourishing, and it leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft and supple. The formula is lightweight and absorbs quickly, making it perfect for both day and night use. I love how it helps to improve the overall texture of my skin. It's a great product that I'll continue to use for years to come. Gifted by Tula.
I've tried 24/7 moisturizer previously and it was fine. I just felt like I was needing more hydration and the ultra hydrating day & night cream definitely gives me more moisture for my face.

I love this moisturizer! It works so well. My skin feels amazing!!!! It feels so soft and it absolutely glows all day long. Love Tula and love this moisturizer so much! Highly recommend for a good moisturizer. Gifted by Tula.

This is my new favorite moisturizer! I love the thickness, it is perfect for dry skin during the winter and doesn't feel as heavy on your skin throughout the day. I'd definitely recommend for dry skin! Gifted by tula:)

I'm absolutely in love! This moisturizer is a game-changer for my dry skin. It's incredibly hydrating, and it leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and plump. The formula is lightweight and absorbs quickly, and it doesn't leave any greasy residue. I love how it helps to soothe my skin and reduce redness. It's the perfect moisturizer for anyone with dry or sensitive skin. Gifted by tula.

This 27-7 moisture intense cream is exactly what my skin needed. I've never seen such fast acting results. This cream is super hydrating and feeds my skin all the things it needs to look way better. I feel hydrated and weightless. Gifted by tula

The texture is rich but not heavy, melting into my skin effortlessly and leaving it soft, plump, and hydrated. From my perspective, it's comforting without being overwhelming, with a smooth, non-greasy finish that layers well under my makeup. The probiotics and peptides stand out to me, and I feel they help keep my skin balanced and healthy. gifted by tula

I absolutely love this moisturizer. It's my go to when my skin needs extra moisturizing. It's a good consistency for all seasons and is fragrance free. It doesn't leave my skin oily or with residue either. Gifted by tula

Hey seriously love Tula so much they never disappoint me. This product is so good for hydrating my skin this winter if you're looking for a good moisturizer, I highly recommend this one it has been a go to this winter. gifted by Tula

Great for all skin types, super hydrating, absorbs quickly without residue and a little goes a long way. It's non greasy, sits well under makeup, is heavy enough for a night cream and light enough for a day cream. It's perfect, I am so glad I found such a great moisturizer. It's gifted by Tula

This moisturizer has helped my skin barrier so much! It has really transformed the skin texture and made it so smooth and hydrated only after a couple of uses. I really recommend this for dry skin. Complimentary from Tula

I was gifted by tula the Tula Skincare 24-7 Moisture Intense Ultra-Hydrating Day and Night Cream and it has been a game-changer for my dry, flaky skin. It transformed my complexion into one that's fully hydrated and healthy-looking. I love that it provides long-lasting moisture throughout the day and night, keeping my skin soft, nourished, and glowing around the clock. Highly recommend!

The Tula 24-7 Moisture Intense Hydrating Day & Night Cream is a standout choice for anyone looking to elevate their skincare routine with deep hydration and a balanced glow. This cream is designed for all-day nourishment and is rich without feeling heavy, making it perfect for morning and evening use. The texture strikes a nice balance—it's creamy and luxurious but absorbs quickly, leaving the skin feeling soft and refreshed rather than greasy. Infused with probiotics and superfoods like watermelon and squalane, it helps to improve skin's natural moisture barrier while providing antioxidant protection. The subtle scent is clean and refreshing, adding a touch of indulgence without being overpowering. After consistent use, my skin felt more hydrated, smoother, and plump. It's a versatile moisturizer that pairs well with serums or treatments and works wonderfully under makeup. If you're looking for a reliable, effective, and non-irritating moisturizer, Tula 24-7 Moisture Intense is worth a try! gifted by tula

I love that it is a thicker consistency that feels like it stays on my skin. The cool smooth texture feels great in the morning and evening. Definitely a moisturizing cream I would recommend to a friend!

avis.titre: Please match the scent to the original
avis.texte: I would have given this 5 stars but I totally wish it had the same scent as the original. I switched to this just for the winter months bc my skin is drier during this time. It's a a great cream…a little goes a long ways and def hydrates. Only thing I would match is the fragrance to the original.

I got this as a sampler and used it for about a week. Everytime i put it on, it burned my face. I thought maybe it was one of the other serums i had on that was having a reaction to, but slowly began to realize it was this moisturizer. I am not experiencing a rash in my eye areas and cheeks.

TULA's 24-7 Moisture Intense is a game-changer! This rich cream delivered instant hydration, leaving my skin plump and radiant. Its blend of probiotics feels luxurious and soothing, perfect for my busy lifestyle. I love how it gives my complexion a healthy glow without any greasiness. A must-try! #gifted by Tulia

My skin gets extremely dry and flaky in the cold winter months. Tula's ultra hydrating day & night cream has a very thick formula that truly offers nourishment for dry skin. It immediately helps relieve dry skin and also helps keep it hydrated. Overall, I strongly recommend to anyone with dry skin! Gifted by Tula.

Feeling Very moisture and hydrated all day, great day and night cream for the winter time. It is not greasy at all. Hopefully it would help with the fine lines. Can't wait to try more and see more results. Gifted by Tula
Definitely worth the purchase, ultra hydration that feels so good

I love this moisturizer! I have very dry skin and need something thick and nourishing especially once the weather gets cold. My skin has already been getting drier & this has helped so much! The packaging is super cute and glittery, and the consistency of the product itself is perfect, it would be great for anyone with dryness or dry patches for sure. Gifted by Tula

Gifted by tula The moisturizer is great for all skin types loving unsalted and using it everyday . I use it in my skincare routine daily am and pm before going to sleep or work. Makes my skin hydrated and nourished.

The Ultra Hydrating Day & Night Cream gifted by TULA Skincare is my favorite moisturizer for the winter. I have combination skin and this cream leaves my face hydrated for hours. I love that it works well with my sensitive skin and that it doesn't feel greasy.

My skin is extremely dry; this cream is like an answer to my prayers. My face little peels and cracks because it is so dehydrated; this made my skin feel so smooth and hydrated without feeling heavy or greasy at all. I would highly recommend to someone who needs major hydration. I was gifted by Tula.

I've been using this moisturizer during the winter, and it's been a lifesaver for my combination, but mostly dry skin. The texture is rich but absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling soft and hydrated all day without any greasiness. I love that it supports my skin barrier, especially with the harsh cold air. It works beautifully under makeup and has noticeably improved my skin's texture. (Gifted by Tula!)

This moisturizer is THICK. I love it. So good for winter! And so hydrating. I'm obsessed. This is my first Tula product and I love it so much. I can't wait to try more. I have dry skin so this is a perfect moisturizer for me since it's so thick. It leaves my skin moisturized and not sticky at all. I love it Complimentary from tula

I have been loving this on my dry skin. I live in an area that is very windy and very cold so in the winter my skin needs this. It's thick but not too thick and provides just the right amount of hydration and protection to my skin. This was gifted by Tula.

The Tula Skincare 24-7 Moisture Intense is absolutely amazing! First off, the scent is super light and clean, so fresh and not overpowering at all. It's perfect if you're not into heavy fragrances. The texture? Dreamy! It's rich without feeling greasy and melts right into your skin. My face felt instantly hydrated and plump, and I was loving the light scent. After using it, my skin looked so dewy and fresh, and it stayed soft all day. Plus, it's so calming—it made my skincare routine feel luxurious. Totally in love with this moisturizer! Gifted by Tula.
very moisturizing without clogging pores - my go to for all seasons

I have combination, sensitive skin. I generally use a light weight moisturizer daily after showering and sometimes at night when I actually bother to wash my face. It's always worked great but I was experiencing a little bit of dryness so I decided to try this. It didn't irritate my skin at any point but it also didn't moisturize my skin. Trying to wear makeup only magnifies the dryness/flaking (and it's a hydrating CC cream).
It's super hydrating, but not greasy, and it makes my skin feel and look better than many other creams I have used that just leave my skin even more dry- this is my winter remedy as well!
Absolute favorite stuff. Thick and creamy without being super greasy.
This is a great moisturizer if you're super dry. Doesn't take much to apply.
Love the moisture intense cream. My skin feels and looks better.
Love the way it makes my skin feel so soft and hydrated. Its nots to thick and last long.
I use this in the winter and the normal 24/7 moisturizer in the summer. This one is thicker which I like to helps to hydrate during dry weather. It works great!

I am 42 and perimenopausal. In the winter especially my skin gets super dry in my t zone and on my chin. I started using ultra hydrating day & night cream and it made a huge difference!! I use it every night, and some mornings. It's also good for "touch ups" during the spring and fall seasons. It's not heavy or greasy and absorbs well. This combined with the hydrating mask twice a week is perfect!!
Love the texture of this. I have dry skin but also break out. Feels very moisturizing without being greasy/oily. Great for daytime under makeup on dry patches, or overnight.
This cream is super hydrating. Your skin feels hydrated and moisturized in the morning. I really like this night cream especially in the winter when it's dry outside.

Best product I've found! I have extremely dry skin, autoimmune diseases. Love this product. It feels great on the skin and keeps my face moisturized well. There is a very very slight smell but dissipates promptly.

This rich cream is exactly what my extremely dry skin needed. It immediately smoothed wrinkles and plumped up my skin. The thick & creamy formula allows these effects to last for hours from only 1 application. It also only requires a small amount to achieve these results, allowing the product to last a long time.
Super moisturizing! Tip: keep it in the fridge and it feels like a hydrating cool mask.

I like to wear this at night. I put it on as the last step to my routine at night. It locks everything in beautifully and my skin feels nice and soft in the morning. I've never tried it on under makeup as I light lighter creams under makeup.
My favorite tula product, super worth it to get the bigger one, it lasts like 3x longer My face has improved so much since using this
Love this stuff. Nice big tub. Not greasy at all & is very effective!!
I originally thought this product would be too much for my skin because it would be too intense but it has worked wonders. This product has kept my face moisturized all day and has not felt oily.
The best face lotion - thick but absorbs well and isn't greasy. Living in Colorado it's so dry and this lotion stands up to it and lasts all day!

Thick cream which is what I look for in a super hydrating moisturizer. In the summer heat, I feel like my face is not dry at all. I have sensitive skin so I'm extra careful about what I use, and I've had no reaction at all. Absolutely love this product. Will continue to use!

This is my go-to moisturizer! I use it day and night. A little goes a long way so this tub last forever! I used to have forehead creases and I swear this stuff has completely eliminated them. I have tried the regular moisturizer as well and prefer the feel of this one. It is creamy and makes my skin feel amazing!

I use tretinoin for acne which dries out my skin and makes it volatile. But not anymore - this moisturizer balances my skin without causing breakouts. I use this at night and use the regular 24/7 moisturizing cream during the day. It's the perfect way to approach my day/ night routine. My skin has never been so calm, and I can use the tretinoin on a daily basis.
If you have dry skin all year round this is for you! And the smell is a soft blueberry ish smell. I love it!
My skin gets incredibly dry every winter and nothing seems to work. But this did!

This has become a holy grail for my aging dry skin! I love it so much. I use it daily, sometimes twice. It's thick, not too thick, not sticky and gives a nice glow. It's helped my dry skin so much and my fine lines aren't as noticeable.

I got this on fab fit fun box. I tried it numerous times on face, neck and hands. It pilled on my skin every time! It looked horrible under makeup. It is too thick! Never again i usually like these products. .
Thick consistency but absorbs well and leaves a glowy finish. Feels super hydrating.
